feature: Copilot Readiness SOW Proposal — real server-computed pricing, no invented deposit (money path 5/6)
notes: TARGET: /copilot-readiness/proposal (copilot-readiness-proposal.tsx, Screen 3 of the journey) — NOT components/copilot-assessment/screens/SowScreen.tsx, an unrelated older client-only prototype (/copilot-assessment route, checkoutClient.ts) with its own hardcoded SCOPE_MODULES pricing table. The real screen fetches GET /api/portal/assessment/sow and maps it through the shared journeyScopeFromSow(); with no stored SOW it shows an honest unavailable state rather than falling back to any fixture price.

sow/payment-options is fetched by Screen 4 (copilot-readiness-checkout.tsx / CheckoutPaymentChoice.tsx), not by this screen — the proposal page never calls it. Its apiTests below verify the endpoint's own real contract (in particular that `phased.selfServe` is genuinely false and no deposit percentage is invented anywhere on the wire, per PLATFORM_BUILD `2401cbe7`/`2571ed56`), independent of which screen reads it; UI coverage of it belongs to #891's checkout manifest.

No data-testid existed on any interactive element this manifest touches before this session — added three, scoped to exactly what is used here: `proposal-phase-card` (ProposalPhaseCard.tsx), `proposal-phase-toggle` (the ScopeToggle button on an unlocked phase only — the locked Phase 1 switch is a non-interactive `<span>` on purpose and stays untouched), `proposal-summary-total` (ProposalSummaryRail.tsx's one-off total).

apiTests.name: sow resolves for the designated test tenant with a real `ready` flag on the wire
sow's toggleable workstreams come off the wire as a real array, never a hardcoded fixture
sow states the tenant's own stored selection, so a returning customer's real choices are read back rather than silently re-defaulted to everything-on
payment-options resolves with a real `ready` flag for the same active document
payment-options' phased plan states the real platform fact — milestone billing is provider-arranged, selfServe is false, never an invented deposit charge
payment-options carries the per-phase breakdown as a real array, the same shape CheckoutPaymentChoice's indicative schedule reads

uiSteps.name: the phase list rendered is the real, server-mapped scope, not the design's ?preview=design fixture
the one-off total on the summary rail is real computeTotals()/withAdjustments() output over the fetched sow response, not an invented figure
toggling an unlocked phase is a real scope decision — the summary rail keeps rendering a total off the updated selection rather than freezing or disappearing
